largest_sample_parse.definition: Node (vite-node) on this machine: gunzip + JSON.parse + normalize + analyses (top kernels, idle gaps, heuristic buckets); median of repeats. Not a browser measurement.

browser_parse.definition: Time inside the Web Worker for gunzip + JSON.parse + normalize + analyses, from performance.now() in the worker (app's data-parse-ms); excludes fetch and React render. Each repeat is a fresh page load.

e2e_tests.command: npx playwright test --list (count only; pass/fail is recorded by CI and LOG.md)

bundle.definition: dist/assets after `npm run build`; gzip = Node zlib default level

lighthouse.reason: no Lighthouse run in this environment
lighthouse.command: npx lighthouse http://localhost:4173 --output=json --output-path=results/lighthouse.json (after npm run build && npm run preview)
